name: Ghostly Arrow
body:
School transmutation; Level druid/shaman 3, elven archer 2, ranger 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, F (an arrow or bolt), DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target arrows or bolts touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Arrows you fire while this spell is in effect are imbued with the spiritual power of the forest; they become misty and insubstantial while in flight. They return to normal when they strike a foe’s corporeal body. Arrows that miss are lost.

Attacking with ghostly arrows requires a successful touch attack. The arrows ignore any AC bonuses for armor or cover from intervening creatures or terrain.
